   - The function was receiving the references array as a second parameter from `runEvaluations`, but was treating it as banned terms
   - Changed the signature to ignore the references parameter and always use the default banned terms
   - This fixed the toxicity score calculation from returning 0 to correctly returning 1 (no toxicity detected)

**Test Results:**
- ✅ All 28 tests now pass across 8 test files
- ✅ All existing public exports remain working

The changes are staged and ready to commit.
